no_ship: You've no ship, dear. I don't hire walkers.
Get yourself a ship first, dear. Then we'll talk.
No ship? Then no, dear. Sit down and have a cup of tea instead.
no_trust: I don't know you. Start with something small.
Small things first, dear. We'll see how you do.
You're new to me. I've nothing that size for new faces.
wanted: Not with security looking for you. Off you go.
You're being looked for, dear. Come back when you aren't.
Not while security wants a word with your lot.
nothing: Nothing just now. Give it a little while.
Nothing for you today, dear. Ask me again later.
I've nothing. Come back in a bit.
burned: You laid hands on one of mine. Go away.
I heard what you did. Go away, dear.
Not after that. Off with you.
trouble: Not while the place is like this, dear.
With bodies on the floor? Not today.
busy: One thing at a time, dear. You've something on already.
You've work already. See to it.
gone: Too slow, dear. Someone else took it.
That's spoken for now. Somebody was quicker.
taken: Good. It's on the paper. Burn it after.
Good. It's all written down. Don't lose it, dear.
That's settled then. Read it somewhere quiet.
pay_clean: Not a whisper about it. That's how I like it. A little extra, dear.
Nobody's said a word. I like that. Something extra for you.
Not a peep from anyone. Here's a little more for your trouble.
pay_some: People are talking, but not about much. It'll do.
A bit of talk, dear. Nothing I can't live with.
I've heard a whisper or two. It'll do.
pay_loud: Half the port saw you. You get what we said and not a chip more.
The whole place is talking, dear. What we agreed, and that's all.
You made a racket. You get the price and nothing on top.
failed: Too late. Come back when I've stopped being cross.
You let me down, dear. Leave it a while.
That's a mess left on my plate. Come back later.
spoiled: Somebody else did that. I don't pay you for their work.
That wasn't your hand, dear. No pay for other people's work.
Someone beat you to it. I pay for what you did, not them.
wait: Give it a minute. Let's hear what the port says first.
Not yet, dear. Let things settle.
Sit a moment. I want to hear the talk first.
not_yours: I didn't give that one to you.
Send whoever I gave it to.
wrong_fixer: That's not for me, dear. Take it where you were told.
Wrong door, dear. Read your note again.
Not mine. It goes where the note says.
offer_sabotage: {name}, by {place}. I'd like it broken before the {clock}. No fuss, dear.
There's {name} by {place}. See it ruined before the {clock}, dear. Quietly.
offer_smuggle: A sealed case for a friend at {to}. It stays shut and it never meets a scanner, dear.
I need a case taken to {to}. Don't open it, and keep it away from the scanners.
offer_breakin: {name} keeps a ledger in a safe by {place}. I'd like that ledger, dear.
There's a safe by {place}. {name}'s. Bring me what's inside, dear. Quietly.
offer_hit: {name}. {look}. He's on the {clock} shuttle and I'd like him to miss it. No fuss, dear.
{name}, {look}. Booked out on the {clock}. I'd rather he never boarded, dear.
offer_evidence: Security took a bag off a friend of mine. It's in their locker. Bring it to me, dear.
There's a bag in the security locker that should be mine. Fetch it, dear.
offer_jailbreak: {name} is sitting in a cell here. {look}. Walk him out and onto your ship, dear.
A friend of mine, {name}, is in a cell. {look}. Get him aboard your ship, dear.
repeat: I'll say it once more, dear.
idle: Where did I put my glasses?

no_ship: No vessel on file. Can't book you.
I only book crews with a hull under them.
no_trust: No history on file. Small orders only.
We start new accounts on small freight.
wanted: Your crew's on a list here. Not doing business.
Security has your name. Clear it first.
nothing: Nothing on the manifest. Try me later.
Manifest's empty for you right now.
burned: We don't do business with you any more.
trouble: Not with the floor like this.
busy: Close out your current order first.
gone: That slot's filled. Somebody was quicker.
taken: Done. It's all on the slip.
pay_clean: Tidy books. There's a margin in that for you.
Not a line out of place. You've earned a margin.
Smooth delivery. I'm adding a margin.
pay_loud: Messy. Contract rate, nothing on top.
That was a write-off and a half. Base rate.
Loud work. You get the rate and that's it.
failed: Missed the window. That's a loss on my side.
You missed delivery. Don't ask me for a while.
spoiled: Someone else delivered. I don't pay you for that.
wait: Give me a minute to reconcile.
not_yours: Account doesn't match. Send the right one.
That order isn't on your name.
wrong_fixer: Deliver it where the slip says.
offer_sabotage: One item, {name}, by {place}. Write it off before the {clock}.
{name} is sitting by {place}. I need it damaged before the {clock}. Quietly.
offer_smuggle: One sealed case to {to}. It doesn't clear inspection, so don't let it.
Courier work. A case for {to}. Keep it shut and away from the scanners.
offer_breakin: A safe by {place}. {name}'s. I need the ledger in it.
{name} keeps books in a safe by {place}. I want those books.
offer_hit: One passenger, {name}, {look}, on the {clock}. I need that booking written off. Quietly.
offer_evidence: Security is holding a bag of mine. Evidence locker. Recover it.
There's an item of mine logged in their evidence locker. Get it back.
offer_jailbreak: {name}, {look}, is held in a cell here. Ship him out on your vessel.
I've a consignment in a cell. {name}. {look}. Get him aboard.

pay_loud: Loud. The price was the price.
Everyone heard. The price. Nothing else.
offer_smuggle: A case. To {to}. Shut. No scanners.
offer_breakin: A safe, by {place}. {name}'s. Bring me the ledger.
offer_hit: {name}. {look}. The {clock}. See that he misses it.
offer_evidence: A bag in their locker. Bring it.
offer_jailbreak: {name}. {look}. In a cell. Out, and onto your ship.
{name}, in a cell. {look}. Aboard your ship.

no_trust: I don't know you. Something small first.
burned: You hurt one of ours. No.
trouble: Not today. Look at the place.
Not with the port like this.
pay_clean: Not a word from anyone. Extra for that.
Nobody's talking. You earned a bit more.
pay_loud: Everyone saw. The price and no more.
Loud. You get what we said.
failed: Too late. Leave it a while.
You let it slip. Not for a while.
spoiled: Someone else did it. No pay.
wrong_fixer: Not for me. Read the note.
offer_sabotage: There's {name} by {place}. Ruin it before the {clock}.
offer_smuggle: A sealed case to {to}. Shut, and away from the scanners.
Take a case to {to}. Don't open it. No scanners.
offer_breakin: A safe by {place}. {name}'s. Bring me the ledger.
{name} keeps a ledger in a safe by {place}. I want it.
offer_hit: {name}. {look}. On the {clock}. See he misses it.
offer_evidence: There's a bag in the security locker. Bring it.
Security took a bag. It's in their locker. Get it.
offer_jailbreak: {name}, {look}, is in a cell. Get him onto your ship.
{name} is in a cell. {look}. Out and aboard.
idle: The old one's not coming back. You get me.

sabotage: Somebody wrecked that new delivery. Did you see?
Somebody did the new drinks machine in. Shame.
Heard a crate got smashed out on the floor.
smuggle: Someone walked a case past the scanners, they say.
There's talk of a case that never got checked.
breakin: Somebody cracked a safe here. Can you believe it?
A safe got opened and nobody saw a thing.
hit: Did you hear about the man who missed his shuttle?
Someone got done in here. Keep your head down.
evidence: Something walked out of the security locker, I heard.
Security lost a bag from their own locker. Ha.
jailbreak: Somebody broke a man out of the cells!
Did you hear? One of the cells is empty.
